lines.en: label mollyspring4:
scene nightsky
Night fell faster than the kingdom of Rome. Meaning that it didn’t take upwards of 200 years for it to happen and that it was actually really quick by comparison.
lines.zh: 夜幕降临得比罗马王国还快。意思是说，它没有花上两百多年，相比之下其实快得要命。

lines.en: Also, Molly never dressed up as a sexy cat or pet her friend. Life is bad and we are all going to die miserable and alone.
lines.zh: 另外，Molly 既没有扮成性感猫咪，也没有摸她的朋友。人生很糟，我们都会凄惨而孤独地死去。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
scene black
Oh, and you missed another event for not having sex with Ami. Way to go, loser. Now you get less of the pervy gamer-girl too.
lines.zh: 哦，对了，因为你没跟 Ami 上床，又错过了一个事件。干得漂亮，废物。现在连那个变态游戏宅女你也少看一段了。

lines.en: The consequences of your inaction are piling up and still you refuse to go back and make her happy.
lines.zh: 你无所作为的后果正在越积越多，可你依旧不肯回头去让她幸福。

lines.en: Why won’t you let her be happy?
lines.zh: 你为什么就是不肯让她幸福？

lines.en: She loves you so much.
lines.zh: 她那么爱你。

lines.en: scene loveami
Just look at that face!
lines.zh: 看看那张脸！

lines.en: $ mollyspring4miss = True
if day >= 6:
jump endofsatch4
else:
jump endofweekdaych4
else:
scene mollyamitrain1
But at least we have legs to look at for now.
lines.zh: 不过至少眼下还有腿可以看。

lines.en: {size=-2}And all we can do is hope that Ami winds up in the same position her uncle/father did a while back where she gets to pseudo-molest Molly from behind on a crowded train while fulfilling another one of the Irish girl’s fantasies.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}我们唯一能做的，就是盼着 Ami 落进她舅舅／爸爸前阵子所处的那个位置——在拥挤的电车上从背后假装猥亵 Molly，顺带实现这个爱尔兰女孩的又一个幻想。{/size}

lines.en: : You know...it wasn’t all that long ago that I almost fulfilled a lifelong fantasy of mine with your dad on this very train route.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……就在不久前，我差点和你爸爸在这条电车线路上实现了我毕生的幻想。

lines.en: Oh. I guess she’s just saying it.
lines.zh: 哦。看来她就这么说出来了。

lines.en: : Lucky. Cause, if it’s the fantasy I’m thinking of, I have the same exact one.
lines.zh: : 真走运。因为，如果我想的那个幻想没错的话，我也有个一模一样的。

lines.en: : I think I heard a while ago that most girls fantasize about that at least once.
lines.zh: : 我记得前阵子听说，大多数女孩至少都幻想过一次那种事。

lines.en: : Are you sure you didn’t hear that most girls experience it at least once?
lines.zh: : 你确定你听说的不是「大多数女孩至少经历过一次」？

lines.en: : I hope not. That’s much less fun and way more sad for those who aren’t as depraved as us.
lines.zh: : 但愿不是。那样就没意思多了，而且对那些没我们这么堕落的人来说，也太可悲了。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain2
: Speaking of things that are both sad and fun, though, I had a good time today. We don’t hang out as much as we should.
lines.zh: : 不过说到既可悲又开心的事，我今天过得很愉快。我们没能像该有的那样常聚。

lines.en: : I concur. What about this is sad, though?
lines.zh: : 我同意。不过这有什么可悲的？

lines.en: : The fact that you’ll forever feel like an outcast despite this being your home country now and how you’ve grown so accustomed to being ostracized that you’ve stopped reacting to it altogether.
lines.zh: : 可悲的是，尽管这里如今已经是你的祖国，你却会永远觉得自己是个外人；而且你已经习惯了被排挤，习惯到干脆连反应都没有了。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain3
: Oh. Well, yes. It is sad when you put it like that. But I’ve had plenty of time to get used to being an outcast, so...
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，好吧。你这么一说确实挺可悲。不过我有的是时间去习惯当一个外人，所以……

lines.en: : I get it. I’m also an outcast, Molly. I’m sure everybody would be looking at me differently if they knew I willingly have sex with my dad.
lines.zh: : 我懂。我也是个外人，Molly。我敢说，要是别人知道我心甘情愿和我爸爸上床，看我的眼神肯定不一样。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene mollyamitrain4
: Hi. I’m Ami. I have sex with my dad.
lines.zh: : 大家好。我叫 Ami。我和我爸爸上床。

lines.en: : As proud as I am to see you unabashedly proclaiming your love for interests that other people would surely look down on, I do think telling strangers about that might be taking it a step too far.
lines.zh: : 看到你毫不遮掩地宣告自己对那些别人肯定会看不起的兴趣的热爱，我很骄傲；不过我觉得，把这种事告诉陌生人可能有点过头了。

lines.en: : Wooooooow. Nihongo jouzu desu ne.
lines.zh: : 哇——哦。你的日语真好呢。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain5
: I think I’m just going to stop talking forever.
lines.zh: : 我想我干脆这辈子都别说话了。

lines.en: : But talking is what makes you {i}you!{/i} Just try to look at the bright side and...be happy about how many people have complimented your speaking today?
lines.zh: : 可说话才是让你成为{i}你{/i}的东西啊！试着往好处想……比如说，今天有多少人夸你日语讲得好，为此开心一下？

lines.en: : They’d be reacting the same way if I just said “thank you.”
lines.zh: : 我要是只说句「谢谢」，他们的反应也会一模一样。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain6
: What can I say? We’re easy to impress and not afraid to hand out compliments.
lines.zh: : 我能说什么呢？我们很容易被取悦，也不吝啬夸奖别人。

lines.en: : The best compliment of all is the lack thereof. That’s why I like hanging out with all of you guys so much. It feels like you’ve actually accepted me.
lines.zh: : 最好的赞美，恰恰是没有任何赞美。这就是我这么喜欢跟你们在一起的原因。感觉你们是真的接纳了我。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain7
: It shouldn’t just {i}feel{/i} like it. We {i}have{/i} accepted you. In fact, we kind of {i}need{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 不该只是{i}感觉{/i}像。我们是{i}真的{/i}接纳你了。事实上，我们还有点{i}需要{/i}你。

lines.en: : Without Molly MacCormack, the manga club would fall apart. The rest of us aren’t nearly as good at sewing. {i}Plus,{/i} I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve used your characters as supports in gacha games.
lines.zh: : 没有 Molly MacCormack，漫画社就散了。我们其他人的缝纫手艺差得远。{i}再说{/i}了，我都不记得有多少次在抽卡游戏里拿你做的角色当支援了。

lines.en: : You’re an invaluable part of our friend group. And you should take solace in the fact that, if anyone was going to be kicked out of it, it would be me. Nobody in their right mind is voting you out first.
lines.zh: : 你是我们这个小圈子里不可取代的一员。而且你该感到宽慰的是，如果真有人要被踢出去，那也会是我。没有哪个脑子正常的人会先投你出局。

lines.en: : I do have fewer death threats under my belt. At least those not shrouded in delusions of grandeur pertaining to assorted virtual worlds.
lines.zh: : 我收到的死亡威胁确实比较少。至少那些没被「各种虚拟世界的宏大妄想」包装过的，确实少。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain8
: I don’t think anyone wants you gone either, though. At least no one in the manga club.
lines.zh: : 不过我也不觉得有谁希望你走。至少漫画社里没人这么想。

lines.en: : I don’t know about that. Yasu’s seemed pretty scared of me lately.
lines.zh: : 那可不好说。Yasu 最近看起来挺怕我的。

lines.en: : Yasu was deathly afraid of the closet for a solid month as well when she thought she heard “the void” inside of it. I think we can write her fears off as mostly nonsensical. Except for when they aren’t.
lines.zh: : Yasu 之前还整整一个月把柜子怕得要死，因为她觉得听见里面有什么「虚空」。我觉得她的恐惧基本可以当胡思乱想处理。除非那回是真的。

lines.en: : Just write everybody off except for us. I got a lot happier when I stopped caring about the world outside of school and home.
lines.zh: : 除了我们，其他人统统划掉就行。自从我不再在乎学校和家以外的世界，我开心多了。

lines.en: : Now, I can tell any random person I see about all the sex I have with my dad and nothing ever changes. Isn’t that great?
lines.zh: : 现在，我可以跟任何一个路人说我跟我爸爸上床的种种，而什么都不会改变。这不是很棒吗？

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain9
: Do you ever wish things {i}would{/i} change, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，你有没有希望过事情{i}会{/i}有所改变？

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如说？

lines.en: : Like...say you’re playing a game. And you’re having a lot of fun with it.
lines.zh: : 比如说……假设你在玩一款游戏。而且你玩得很开心。

lines.en: : But then one day, all of a sudden, you feel like starting over before you’ve even finished.
lines.zh: : 可某一天，你突然就想在还没通关之前从头再来。

lines.en: : Maybe you got to a part that was too difficult. Or maybe you’re just not liking how you built your character or something.
lines.zh: : 也许是你卡在了一段太难的地方。或者你只是不喜欢自己把角色养成这样什么的。

lines.en: : So you make an alt...or start a new save file...and do things a little differently than you did last time just to see what it’s like.
lines.zh: : 于是你开了个小号……或者新建了一个存档……然后做一些和上次不太一样的选择，就为了看看会是什么样。

lines.en: : I feel like that sometimes. Like what I’ve {i}been{/i} doing isn’t really what I {i}want{/i} to do even though it probably is or I wouldn’t have done it at all. You know?
lines.zh: : 我有时候就有这种感觉。像是自己{i}一直在做{/i}的事其实并不是我{i}想做{/i}的——尽管它大概就是我想做的，否则我根本不会去做。你懂吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I think I get what you mean. I feel like that sometimes too.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想我明白你的意思。我有时候也有这种感觉。

lines.en: scene black
: It’s still the same game at the end of the day, though.
lines.zh: : 不过说到底，那还是同一款游戏。

lines.en: : And even if there are multiple endings, most of what you see is going to be the same.
lines.zh: : 而且就算有多个结局，你看到的东西大部分还是一样的。

lines.en: : That said, I think it’s more important {i}to{/i} see the ending before you do something as dramatic as starting a new save file. Unless you’re one of those people who’s just {i}afraid{/i} to ever end things.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，我觉得在做出「新建存档」这么戏剧性的事之前，先看到结局更重要。除非你是那种{i}害怕{/i}给任何事收尾的人。

lines.en: : Besides, there are too many games out there to keep playing the same one.
lines.zh: : 再说了，外面的游戏太多了，没必要一直玩同一款。

lines.en: : The hard part is actually {i}finding{/i} them.
lines.zh: : 难的是真的{i}找到{/i}它们。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain10
Whether there was a double meaning or not to what Ami Arakawa was saying didn’t really matter. The words still resonated with Molly either way.
lines.zh: Ami Arakawa 的话有没有双关，其实并不重要。不管怎样，那些话都触动了 Molly。

lines.en: This life and way of living were all she’d ever known. But even though it was the path she chose, it still felt, more often than not, that she’d unintentionally locked herself out of a ton of content.
lines.zh: 这种生活、这种活法，是她唯一知道的一切。可尽管这是她自己选的路，她还是常常觉得，自己无意间把大量内容锁在了门外。

lines.en: In fact, in some alternate universe, even {i}this{/i} was probably missable. But if it was, would it even be because of {i}her?{/i} Or would it be the result of something else?
lines.zh: 事实上，在某个平行宇宙里，就连{i}这{/i}本身大概也是可以错过的。可如果真是这样，那会是{i}她{/i}的缘故吗？还是别的什么造成的？

lines.en: Is there {i}anything{/i} she can do at this point to change her fate? Or have the route and its ending already been written?
lines.zh: 事到如今，她还能做{i}什么{/i}来改变自己的命运吗？还是说，这条路线和它的结局早已写好了？

lines.en: There’s no way to know but waiting it out.
lines.zh: 除了等下去，别无他法。

lines.en: Or rather, there {i}is.{/i}
lines.zh: 或者说，其实{i}有{/i}。

lines.en: She just doesn’t know about it yet.
lines.zh: 只是她还不知道而已。

lines.en: : Do you ever wonder what it’s like to be cool?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过，做一个酷的人是什么感觉？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太想过，没有。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain11
: Me either. I’m glad we’re on the same page.
lines.zh: : 我也是。很高兴我们想法一致。

lines.en: : You and I are on the same page pretty much all the time. You’re the only person I know who never really had any sort of crazy reaction to finding out I’m an incestuous daughterslut.
lines.zh: : 你和我几乎总是想到一块儿去。在知道我是个跟爸爸乱伦的女儿婊之后，你是我认识的人里唯一一个没什么过激反应的。

lines.en: : I was desensitized to incest long before I even met you. Your relationship with the Supreme Overlord is but one more example of how the barrier between fiction and reality has dissolved into nothing for me.
lines.zh: : 早在遇见你之前，我就对乱伦脱敏了。你和至高霸主的关系，不过是又一个例证，说明虚构与现实之间的界限对我来说已经消融殆尽了。

lines.en: : Meaning that you would also have sex with your dad?
lines.zh: : 意思是说，你也会和你爸爸上床？

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain12
: That...is not what I meant. No.
lines.zh: : 那……不是我的意思。不是。

lines.en: : One day, I’m going to find someone who responds positively to that question. Mark my words. I can’t be the only teenage girl out there who understands how hot this is.
lines.zh: : 总有一天，我会找到一个对这个问题给出肯定回答的人。记住我的话。我不可能是唯一一个明白这有多带感的十几岁女孩。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain13
: Can I ask you something about that, actually?
lines.zh: : 其实，我能问你一个相关的问题吗？

lines.en: : Anything. Nobody ever wants to talk to me about it and I have so much to get off of my chest.
lines.zh: : 什么都可以。从来没人愿意跟我聊这件事，我有太多话想一吐为快。

lines.en: : I just want to know if you think there’s a chance you might actually...you know...
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，你觉得有没有可能你真的会……你知道的……

lines.en: : {i}Win.{/i}
scene mollyamitrain14
: Why wouldn’t there be?
lines.zh: 为什么不可能？

lines.en: : There {i}might{/i} be. I don’t...really know.
lines.zh: {i}也许{/i}有吧。我不……太确定。

lines.en: : I have a hard time getting in the heads of other people. You saw how I was with Rin. It’s just tough for me to comprehend what’s...romantically {i}possible{/i} at times.
lines.zh: 我很难揣摩别人在想什么。你看到我跟 Rin 的时候是什么样了。有时候我就是很难理解，什么在恋爱上是……{i}有可能{/i}的。

lines.en: : And even if you and Sir love each other as deeply as it seems you do, you’re still a {i}niche{/i} pick in terms of a heroine. A fetish, even. But I don’t mean that in a bad way.
lines.zh: 而且，就算你和老师爱得看起来那么深，作为女主角，你依然属于{i}小众{/i}口味。甚至可以说是一种癖好。不过我这么说没有贬低的意思。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain15
: You and I are similar in that regard. Just, for me, there’s a cultural barrier instead of a familial one. One that I don’t understand how to purify or...dispel. Nor do I know if I even {i}can.{/i}
lines.zh: : 在这一点上你我很像。只不过，我面前的是一道文化壁垒，而不是家庭壁垒。一道我不知道该怎么净化、或者……驱散的壁垒。我也不知道自己到底{i}能不能{/i}做到。

lines.en: : Which is part of why I don’t feel entitled to see him as anything more than what he’s been to me. But {i}you{/i} do.
lines.zh: : 这也是为什么我不觉得自己有资格把他看成比现在更多的什么。但{i}你{/i}有。

lines.en: : So is that just an example of my feelings being weaker than yours? Is it an example of me being weak as a whole? Or am I just...{i}right{/i} in thinking that my chances are worse than everyone else’s?
lines.zh: : 那么，这只是说明我的感情比你淡吗？还是说明我整个人都很软弱？又或者……我只是{i}正确{/i}地认识到，我的机会比别人差？

lines.en: : Is this because of the annoying racist lady?
lines.zh: 是因为那个烦人的种族歧视大婶吗？

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain16
: You not being Japanese doesn’t make any difference at all, Molly. And I know it might it feel like it does, but it doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 你不是日本人这件事，一点区别都没有，Molly。我知道你可能觉得有，但其实没有。

lines.en: : Love is love no matter what shape it takes. And if someone like {i}me{/i} can win, which I fully intend to, of course someone like {i}you{/i} can win as well.
lines.zh: : 爱就是爱，不管它是什么形状。如果连{i}我{/i}这样的人都能赢——我是一定会赢的——那{i}你{/i}这样的人当然也能赢。

lines.en: : I’m sorry if that was an odd question. This is just a...conservative country. And I know that things like this can be frowned upon at times.
lines.zh: : 如果这问题问得奇怪，我很抱歉。这里毕竟是个……保守的国家。我也知道这种事有时会被人皱眉头。

lines.en: : We’re in high school, Molly. I think there are bigger things to be frowned upon than your race.
lines.zh: : 我们还在上高中呢，Molly。我觉得比起你的种族，值得皱眉头的事多了去了。

lines.en: : So if by some stroke of luck I {i}do{/i} take on a bigger role one day...what then?
lines.zh: : 那么，如果哪天我走了狗屎运，{i}真的{/i}扮演了更重要的角色……那会怎样？

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain17
: Will we still be friends? Or will you refuse to accept me? Because that will surely play a role in my decision as well.
lines.zh: : 我们还会是朋友吗？还是说你会不肯接受我？因为这肯定也会影响我的决定。

lines.en: : Would it really? You like me that much?
lines.zh: : 真的会吗？你那么喜欢我？

lines.en: : Of course. You and the rest of the girls in the manga club are the first {i}real{/i} friends I’ve ever had. Or at least that’s what my dad would call you since you’re not encased inside of a computer monitor.
lines.zh: : 当然。你和漫画社的其他女生，是我这辈子第一批{i}真正{/i}的朋友。至少我爸爸会这么称呼你们——因为你们不是被封在显示器里的。

lines.en: : We would still be friends, Molly. Of {i}course{/i} we’d still be friends.
lines.zh: 我们当然还会是朋友，Molly。我们{i}当然{/i}还会是朋友。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain18
: I just wouldn’t let that get in the way of me having sex with him and he’d probably cheat on you a whole bunch since me and him are addicted to each other’s bodies.
lines.zh: : 我只是不会让这件事妨碍我和他上床，而且他大概会背着你偷吃很多次，毕竟我和他对彼此的身体都上瘾了。

lines.en: : Well, if it is an addiction, I suppose it can’t be helped. This seems like a fair enough compromise for me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果是上瘾的话，那我想也没办法了。这对我来说算是个挺公平的妥协了。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain19
: It goes both ways too. I don’t mind you coming over to help get him off if I’m ever busy or something. {i}Niki’s{/i} the one we’ve gotta look out for. She hates fun.
lines.zh: : 这也是双向的。要是我哪天忙不过来，你来帮他解决一下我也不介意。我们真正要提防的是 {i}Niki{/i}。她讨厌好玩的事。

lines.en: : Are you getting off here? I still have a few more stops to go meet up with Rin and Futaba.
lines.zh: : 你要在这站下吗？我还得坐几站去和 Rin 还有 Futaba 碰头。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’ve got some errands to run before I go try to seduce my dad as a cat.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我得先办点事，然后要扮成猫去勾引我爸爸。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain20
: Let’s do this again, though! I always have fun when it’s just us two.
lines.zh: : 不过我们下次再约吧！只有我们两个的时候，我总是很开心。

lines.en: : I’m free next weekend as well. I’ll be working on the campaign if you want to come over.
lines.zh: : 我下周末也有空。我会打磨战役，你要是想过来就来。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain21
: It’s a date. I’ll text you later to tell you how Operation: Daughterpussy went.
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了。回头我发消息告诉你「女儿穴行动」进展如何。

lines.en: : Please be mindful of the things you say in crowds. Even I’m not that brazen.
lines.zh: : 在人多的地方说话请注意点。连我都没那么不要脸。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain22
: Attention, everyone! My name is Ami Arakawa and I have {i}tons{/i} of sex with my dad! So if you ever see me again, please point at me and shout about it! The whole world should know!
lines.zh: : 大家注意了！我叫 Ami Arakawa，我和我爸爸上过{i}无数次{/i}床！所以你们要是再见到我，请指着我大声喊出来！全世界都该知道！

lines.en: : Or...do that.
lines.zh: : 或者……那样也行。

lines.en: : I suppose that works too.
lines.zh: : 我想那样也算数。

lines.en: scene mollyamitrain23
: A date, huh?...
lines.zh: : 约会啊，是吗？……

lines.en: scene black
: Should I wear my dress again?
lines.zh: : 我要不要再穿那条裙子？

lines.en: Whether there was a different meaning or not to what Ami Arakawa said didn’t really matter. The words still resonated with Molly either way.
lines.zh: Ami Arakawa 的话有没有别的意思，其实并不重要。不管怎样，那些话都触动了 Molly。

lines.en: And as her train kept on to its destination, she was glad that she had finally felt {i}seen.{/i}
lines.zh: 电车继续驶向目的地，她很高兴自己终于被{i}看见{/i}了。

lines.en: But would these feelings spiral the same ways they did the {i}last{/i} time she thought a classmate {i}saw{/i} her?
lines.zh: 可这些感情，会不会像{i}上次{/i}她以为有同学{i}看见{/i}她时那样，再次失控地盘旋下去？

lines.en: This was one more thing she’d struggle to wrap her head around.
lines.zh: 这又是一件她难以想通的事。

lines.en: Fortunately, she’d be able to turn it off once she made it back home.
lines.zh: 所幸，等她回到家就能把这些关掉了。

lines.en: And as she crawled beneath the covers, letting the glow of her cell phone illuminate the shallow depths of the tiny fortress she had built to hide from her sleeping roommate, her lips parted.
lines.zh: 她钻进被窝，任手机的光照亮那座她为了躲开熟睡室友而搭起的、浅浅的小小堡垒，双唇微微张开。

lines.en: Her legs spread.
lines.zh: 她的双腿分开。

lines.en: And shallow breaths escaped her while her hand danced beneath her shorts.
lines.zh: 短促的喘息从她唇间漏出，而她的手在短裤底下起舞。

lines.en: All to the tune of a red-headed catgirl and a picture of her latest misdeed.
lines.zh: 这一切的配乐，是一个红发猫娘，和她最新一次恶作剧的照片。
